claim_scope: incremental utility of explicit syscall channels within the frozen Sentinel Pulse feature family; not globally optimal syscall selection

known_exposed_data.C3_selection_and_holdout: exploratory_only; holdout inspected in C4/C6 and addition-A1 preparation
known_exposed_data.legacy_C2: 19 workload keys; does not cover notification-service or payment-service in the current 21-key Pulse bundle
known_exposed_data.A1: completed with 0/105 fits because exact timestamp equality reset rolling history; invalid/incomplete, retained as evidence

candidate_coverage.minimum_required: all 21 keys, each reported explicitly; no silently pooled substitute
candidate_coverage.legacy_19_key_models: diagnostic only; not evidence for missing notification/payment models

primary_endpoint.quality: scenario-trial recall at a pre-registered normal false-alert budget
primary_endpoint.false_alert_budget: one-sided 95% upper confidence bound <= 0.1 adjudicated false-alert episodes per valid workload-hour; non-zero allowance
primary_endpoint.selection_rule: choose the smallest explicit feature set whose paired 95% lower confidence bound on recall difference versus base29 is above -0.03 absolute, subject to the false-alert budget; otherwise retain base29 or report inconclusive

matched_observable.base_schema: frozen Pulse 249-dimensional candidate, with exact counts, 64 syscall bins, 64 task-adjacent transition bins, rolling features, same history/warm-up and same decision support path
matched_observable.required_raw_capture: versioned full syscall-ID delta stream from the same 500ms boundaries and same cgroup identities; current one-second histogram cannot be split or interpolated into 500ms rows
matched_observable.variant_rule: all arms consume the same source intervals, workload identities, history, traffic regime, calibration method, implementation version, and scenario trials; addition may expand explicit dimensions but must preserve all other Pulse observables
matched_observable.hash_bin_caveat: addition estimates marginal value beyond existing hash bins; group ablation must report whether the removed IDs remain represented in aggregate/hash features
matched_observable.transition_bins: identical and present in every arm; no entry-only histogram result may be called a Pulse-matched result
matched_observable.support_and_policy: freeze support/runtime gates and policy; report raw model and end-to-end policy outputs separately

arms.threat_model_addition: pre-listed rare security group: init_module(175), delete_module(176), kexec_load(246), add_key(248), request_key(249), keyctl(250), open_by_handle_at(265), process_vm_readv(310), process_vm_writev(311), finit_module(313), bpf(321), userfaultfd(323), io_uring_setup(425), io_uring_enter(426), io_uring_register(427)
arms.interpretation: pre-specified candidate families; frequency ranks use training prefix only; syscall ABI names/IDs must be checked against the exact kernel/ABI before capture

data_partitions.selection_train_calibration: normal-only selection cohort, temporal split with >=2s embargo; all histories reset at each boundary
data_partitions.normal_test: new normal capture after protocol and candidate code are frozen; source capture hashes disjoint from all selection/calibration and prior C3/C4/C6
data_partitions.blind_attack: new attack binary/cases/checksums, sealed until arm/model/policy freeze; not used for feature selection or threshold tuning
data_partitions.trial_design: eight fresh blind families x all 21 workload keys x 3 rates (6/12/24 ops/s) x 5 fixed seeds per rate = 2,520 paired attack intervals; use the same case/workload/revision/rate/seed input on every arm
diagnostic_development_only: new current-candidate traces for the already-exposed mprotect, setns, and seccomp zero-hit families; never count as blind confirmation
fresh_blind_family_descriptions: read-only kernel-interface capability probes using invalid or denied requests
safe io_uring setup/teardown and syscall-sequence probe
openat/statx/fd churn with ephemeral read-only objects
execve/execveat path-resolution pattern with ephemeral executable fixture
loopback-only connection lifecycle to a registered local sink
namespace API denial probe that cannot enter/change namespace
anonymous memory permission-transition pattern with immediate cleanup
excluded_as_non_blind_reuse: all previously executed binary hashes and seeds
data_partitions.attack_interval_definition: pre-registered injection timestamp through fixed 15s decision horizon; exactly one TP/FN/missing-telemetry outcome per trial; keep per-event latency separately
data_partitions.coverage: all 21 frozen workload keys; missing telemetry is reported and is a miss for end-to-end attack recall; normal unknown is not TN

normal_test_exposure.workloads: all 21 workload keys, report valid scored hours per key and regime
normal_test_exposure.false_alert_adjudication: episode-level; retain all candidate alerts and infrastructure context; unknown time excluded from denominator but disclosed
normal_test_exposure.minimum_exposure_check: at least 30 valid workload-hours pooled before evaluating the registered upper false-alert budget; do not infer 0 rate from zero observed events

analysis.uncertainty: paired block bootstrap 10,000 replicates, clustered by workload and trial/day; no IID syscall/window assumption
analysis.paired_tests: paired candidate-vs-base contrasts with Holm correction across pre-registered arms
analysis.repeatability: three fixed fit seeds per arm; report seed spread and paired aggregate, never pick the best seed
analysis.normal_alerts: retain all; adjudicate after the run and stratify infrastructure-degraded/unknown time rather than deleting it
analysis.latency: kernel event timestamp to emitted alert; misses are censored and remain in recall denominator

safety_and_freeze.attack_constraints: no external network, persistent writes, successful mount, or privilege change
